title: Decide, Ask, or Defer: Clinical LLMs under Incomplete Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.04542v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Clinical LLMs must decide not only what diagnosis to produce, but also whether the available evidence is sufficient for autonomous decision making. Binary DECIDE/ABSTAIN formulations merge distinct non decision states and do not explicitly evaluate information acquisition. We introduce a DECIDE/ASK/DEFER formulation together with a blinded protocol that prevents models from using evidence completeness metadata. We evaluate Qwen, Gemini, and GPT on 200 matched clinical evidence states constructed from DDXPlus. The models show substantial differences in action selection under identical evidence, with disagreement in 137 of 200 states. For Qwen, a matched targeted versus random analysis shows that selected information changes the likelihood of a subsequent autonomous decision more clearly than diagnostic correctness. translated_title: 决策、询问还是推迟：不完整证据下的临床大语言模型
translated_abstract: 临床大语言模型不仅必须决定产生何种诊断，还必须判断现有证据是否足以支持自主决策。二元的决策/弃权框架将不同的非决策状态混为一谈，且未显式评估信息获取过程。我们提出了决策/询问/推迟的三分类框架，并配有一种盲测协议，防止模型利用证据完整性元数据。我们在基于DDXPlus构建的200个匹配临床证据状态上评估了Qwen、Gemini和GPT。结果表明，在相同证据下，各模型在行动选择上存在显著差异，200个状态中有137个出现分歧。对于Qwen而言，匹配的定向获取与随机获取对比分析显示，所选信息对后续自主决策可能性的改变比对诊断正确性的改变更为明显。其匹配的决策/弃权基线进一步揭示了安全性与自主性之间的权衡：三行动策略挽救了一些错误……
tldr: 该论文提出决策/询问/推迟三分类框架及盲测协议，发现临床大语言模型在相同证据下行动选择差异巨大，定向信息获取更能提升自主决策率，并揭示出安全性与自主性之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a DECIDE/ASK/DEFER formulation with a blinded protocol, showing that clinical LLMs diverge substantially in action selection under identical evidence, that targeted information acquisition improves autonomous decision-making, and that a safety-autonomy tradeoff exists.
